items.definition:
treaty
The two countries signed a peace treaty.

devil
He said he felt like the devil was on his shoulder.

participation
Her involvement in the project was crucial for its success.

a formal request
They started a petition to save the local park.

a piece of armor
The knight carried a sword and a shield.

the main body of a plant; a root word
The rose has a long, thorny stem.

a brave fighter
The ancient warrior fought bravely in battle.

the quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment
He shared his wisdom with the younger generation.

the process of keeping financial records
She is studying accounting at university.

a person or thing that carries something
The airline is a major carrier of international passengers.

a famous person
She became a celebrity after winning the competition.

the activity of training or instructing
His coaching helped the team win the championship.

a preselected option; failure to fulfill an obligation
The computer settings are set to default.

a conversation between two or more people
The play had very witty dialogue.

a basic structure underlying a system
We need a legal framework for this new technology.

an authorization granted to an individual or group to sell a company's goods or services
He bought a fast-food franchise.

reciprocal action or influence
Social interaction is important for mental health.

a shape produced by a curve that bends around and crosses itself
The road makes a loop around the park.

a suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action
Do you have any recommendations for a good restaurant?

an act of giving up something valued for the sake of something else regarded as more important or worthy
Parents often make sacrifices for their children.

the choice or control of the time when something happens
The timing of the announcement was perfect.

low frequency sound; a type of fish
The bass in the music was very strong.

the thicker end of something; a target; buttocks
He flicked the cigarette butt into the ashtray.

a feature or quality belonging typically to a person, place, or thing
A key characteristic of the species is its long tail.

the action of working with someone to produce or create something
The project was a successful collaboration between the two teams.

a disadvantage; a confidence trick
We weighed the pros and cons of the proposal.

careful thought; a factor to be taken into account
After much consideration, we decided to accept the offer.

a system of millions or billions of stars, together with gas and dust, held together by gravitational attraction
Our solar system is part of the Milky Way galaxy.

a deep inlet of the sea almost surrounded by land, with a narrow mouth; a wide gap or difference
The Gulf of Mexico is a large body of water.

the most interesting or memorable part
The highlight of the trip was visiting the ancient ruins.

purpose or aim
His intent was to finish the project on time.

the ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions
She showed good judgment in a difficult situation.

a man who served his sovereign or lord as a mounted soldier in armor
The knight wore shining armor.

the act of stopping something from happening
Disease prevention is crucial for public health.

harm done to someone as a punishment for harm they have done to you
He sought revenge for the injustice.

a country or person that helps another in a war or conflict
They became close allies during the war.

a public sale in which goods or property are sold to the highest bidder
The painting was sold at auction for a high price.

complete disorder and confusion
The sudden announcement caused complete chaos.

the ability to give all your attention to one thing
Studying requires a lot of concentration.

a disagreement or argument
They had a dispute over the property.

edge; difference
Please write your notes in the margin of the page.

a system of parts working together
The clock's internal mechanism is very complex.

a long or arduous search for something
The knights embarked on a quest for the Holy Grail.

a sudden disabling attack; a single movement
He suffered a stroke that affected his speech.

the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial
The new software has great utility for data analysis.

a ship or large boat; a container
The ancient vessel was discovered at the bottom of the sea.

prolonged public disagreement or argument
The new policy sparked a lot of controversy among the public.

a meeting, often unexpected
Their first encounter was at a coffee shop.

the state of being equal
They fought for equality and justice.

a person who protects or looks after someone or something
She was appointed as the child's legal guardian.

a person who loves someone or something
He was a great lover of classical music.

the ideas, attitudes, or activities that are regarded as normal or conventional
His ideas are outside the mainstream.

an illegal act; a crime
He was charged with a minor offense.

a person who has been forced to leave their country
The camp provided shelter for thousands of refugees.

a tear or cut in something
There was a small rip in his jacket.

a part of something larger
We watched a news segment about the election.

extreme fear
The city lived in terror after the attacks.

first letter of the Greek alphabet; dominant individual
Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.

a line that marks the limits of an area
The river forms a natural boundary between the two countries.

a general rule, principle, or piece of advice
The company issued new guidelines for remote work.

an act of asking for information
We received an inquiry about our new product.

compassion or forgiveness shown toward someone
The judge showed mercy to the young offender.

prejudice, discrimination, or antagonism directed against someone of a different race
Racism is a serious social issue.

tribute
The concert was a tribute to the late singer.
